implementation.change: Admit the bounded Environment complete CLI operation over the existing Control-owned authenticated AF_UNIX bridge.
authorization: Require the existing per-execution project grant and peer credential check.
Check the session authenticated principal against the grant before launching Environment.
Pass the authenticated principal and stable RPC request identity to Environment.
Keep all Store paths and file descriptors outside the sandbox.
implementation.service_model: No new daemon or filesystem proxy; the existing Control service remains the canonical Store persistence boundary.

covers: authenticated principal and RPC request identity injection

scoped_static_checks.ruff_select: E4,E7,E9,F passed on changed Python files

limitations: The project-scoped completion surface is the existing Environment CLI bridge; no direct unrestricted host-side MCP completion operation was added.
Environment owns completion semantics and Store mutations; Control only authenticates and transports the bounded request.
